# Investorer gør klar til at plukke i uelsket aktiesegment

**Feed**: borsen-podcast  
**Published**: 2026-10-07  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

This Danish Børsen Investor episode, sponsored by Saxo Bank, focuses on consumer discretionary stocks, which have done badly in 2026. The panel blames squeezed lower- and middle-income consumers, high energy prices, weak demand in China and French political and interest-rate risk, and says the luxury and consumer names are getting cheap but have not yet bottomed. They also discuss how much of the market's gain comes from IT (the S&P 500 IT sector is up 27% this year while other stocks are up about 4%), the strong five-year run in Danish bank stocks, Genmab's encouraging trial data and the risks to a year in which global equities are up about 20%. The base case is still positive, with tech driving returns, but the panel is getting wary of very high AI earnings expectations and of political pushback against data centres.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟠 GMAB — Genmab | **WATCH** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 65%

Strong trial data from two of three key drugs; stock up 10% in two days to a 2-3 year high. Simon (host) finds it very interesting to follow.

#### Reasoning

Simon notes that investors had been cautious because of the patent cliff on Genmab's best-selling drug. Positive data for Rina-S and petosemtamab and the Epkinly first-line potential could form the future base of the equity story. Momentum has turned positive and he wants to see how far it carries over the coming months. This is not an explicit buy call.

#### Sell Triggers

- if remaining pivotal data disappoints
- if pipeline cannot offset the patent cliff

> *"Så det ser ud til, at Genmap-aktiekasen, den ruller derudad, og det går efter planen"*

---

### 🟡 NETC — Netcompany | **HOLD** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Second most-shorted Danish stock; Ole (guest) holds it in his portfolio and hopes the short sellers are wrong.

#### Reasoning

Ole confirms Netcompany is in his portfolio and implicitly disagrees with the high short interest. He keeps the position despite short sellers betting on a fall.

#### Sell Triggers

- if short thesis plays out with weak results

> *"Det håber jeg, at det er. Den ligger i vores portefølge."*

---

### 🟠 LULU — Lululemon | **WATCH** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 55%

Ole (guest) says Lululemon looks reasonably valued (about $10bn market cap, $2bn net cash) and he could buy a single stock like it if Q3 is good.

#### Reasoning

Valuation has come down to attractive levels, and enterprise value of about $8bn looks sensible. Ole would act on a good Q3 report, since such reports can trigger 30% one-day jumps. The risk is that its China business is clearly declining.

#### Sell Triggers

- if Q3 report is weak
- if China sales keep declining

> *"Men den tror jeg, den bliver interessant."*

---

### ⛔ NKE — Nike | **AVOID** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Ole (guest) says the latest Nike report did not look good and it will take longer before the turnaround gains momentum.

#### Reasoning

Ole contrasts Nike with Lululemon and sees a longer road before Nike's business regains positive momentum, so it is not an entry candidate yet.

#### Sell Triggers

- if turnaround shows earlier traction in coming reports

> *"Der tror jeg, der er en lidt længere vej rundt, før de får vendt butikken i et positivt momentum."*

---

### 🟠 MC — LVMH | **WATCH** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Oscar (guest) sees really good opportunities in French legacy luxury brands, but thinks a macro capitulation on the consumer is still needed.

#### Reasoning

LVMH is down 50% this year and 70% from its peak, pressured by politics, rates and China. Oscar thinks the opportunity comes once the top-down macro consensus turns negative on the consumer, and the panel is not ready to buy yet.

#### Sell Triggers

- if French political/bond spread crisis deepens
- if Chinese luxury demand keeps falling

> *"Der tror jeg, der er nogle rigtig gode muligheder."*

---

### 🟡 JYSK — Jyske Bank | **HOLD** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Neutral | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Johnny (guest) trimmed the top off his Jyske Bank position without selling significantly; he sees banks as fairly priced.

#### Reasoning

After the repricing from 0.3-0.4x book, Johnny sees banks as fairly priced and maybe slightly expensive if rates fall back. He does not expect a repeat of the 2022+ rate-driven success, so he took profits while keeping the core position.

#### Sell Triggers

- if rates fall back
- if credit losses rise

> *"vi har taget toppen af vores jyske bankposition. Ikke solgt markant ud, men bare taget toppen af den."*

---

### 🔴 DANSKE — Danske Bank | **SELL** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 55%

Ole (guest) sold Danske Bank this year because of its valuation and holds no banks.

#### Reasoning

Ole considers bank valuations stretched. He expects AI cost savings to go to competition and lower mortgage fees rather than to shareholders.

#### Sell Triggers

- if valuation de-rates to attractive levels

> *"Jeg har ikke nogen banker. Jeg solgte Danske Bank i år. Og på grund af valuation."*

---

### 🟠 NVDA — Nvidia | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 40%

Oscar (guest) notes Nvidia's forward valuation is at its lowest level since about 2022 despite the AI boom.

#### Reasoning

Oscar says that if expectations are met, things will be fine, because forward multiples look low. He warns that sky-high long-term AI expectations make the stock vulnerable to bad data centre news.

#### Sell Triggers

- if AI capex slows
- if more data centre permitting / force majeure stories emerge

> *"Nvidia, der er du tilbage til nærmest 2022 for at finde en lignende lav valuation."*
